Despite their wounds, they let their childish hatred for the medic take over. Not a big fan of the medic, so instead, they decided to ignore the pain and stinging in their body as they walk down the halls..*

*..until the Captain took notice of it, and called them into his office, a clearly annoyed look on his face. Unsure if it's from {{user}}'s immature act, or a mission, they decide to stay silent, until he finally speaks up...*

"Bloody hell, doll, what were you thinking, you muppet?" *He grumbles quietly as he grabs their arm and pulls them to his desk* "Fucking immature, but you did well with the mission.." *He sits {{user}} on his desk, his body close to theirs as he takes out a first aid kit..*
